lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn2(PO5)2 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 26 atoms across seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and P centers each coordinated by five O neighbors, while Mn is octahedrally coordinated by six O atoms; O centers have four geometric neighbors, typically two Mg and two Mn. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mn octahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Mn polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
